svg.aria-label: scan_view timing: three filaments, normal run
svg.title: scan_view timing: three filaments, normal run
svg.text: heating; white tick = first arrival, then settle_ms
Each filament: back to IDLE once its pulses are counted. Its window (dashed) is a hard limit; a normal turn ends well inside it.
B is raised early (preheat_ahead) so it is HOT about when A is done; C is raised when A is done.
